description: Flow templates — the rails of the hybrid conductor (Phase 6 of notes/smart-pipeline-and-found-audio.md). The conductor instantiates one of these into a per-session pipeline.json, pruning/adapting within guardrails (validated against contracts.json). `mode` maps to a skill mode; `parallel: true` marks a step that only needs requirements.json and can run alongside others. requirements is listed first for completeness — it has already run by the time the conductor builds the pipeline.

standard-vo.description: The canonical flow: authored script + generated/recorded voiceover. Default for normal videos.

found-audio-collage.description: Bumblebee-style: narration synthesized from found audio. audio:found-fetch builds a pool, scriptwriter:arranger sequences it, audio:assemble stitches it into audio.wav. The script depends on the audio pool — the inversion the rigid flow could not express.
